SAY: I can agree to weekend gatherings of 4 or fewer with advance notice, ending by 9pm, and I'll take family calls in my room at low volume, wrapping up by 10pm.

FLX:[gwk:gatherings capped at 4 people, with notice, ending by 9pm|instead of my usual under-10 limit]
FLX:[nzl:calls in my room at low volume, wrapped up by 10pm|on the occasional late call I'll text or use headphones]
PFR:[cln:a 4 vs 5 gap is fine with a rotating chore chart, and I'm open to how the chores are split]
